documentaries.title: Free Solo
documentaries.description: Climber Alex Honnold attempts to scale El Capitan in Yosemite National Park, a 3,000-foot granite wall, without ropes or safety gear.

documentaries.title: My Octopus Teacher
documentaries.description: A filmmaker forges an unlikely friendship with an octopus living in a South African kelp forest, learning as much about himself as about the animal.

documentaries.title: March of the Penguins
documentaries.description: Every year, emperor penguins trek across the Antarctic to breed, enduring brutal cold and months of hardship to raise their young.

documentaries.title: Earth
documentaries.description: A year-long journey following polar bears, elephants, humpback whales and more as they migrate across the planet's most extreme landscapes.

documentaries.title: Apollo 11
documentaries.description: Built entirely from restored archival footage and audio, this film relives the 1969 mission that put the first humans on the Moon.

documentaries.title: Icarus
documentaries.description: A filmmaker sets out to expose flaws in sports anti-doping tests and instead stumbles into a vast Russian state-sponsored doping scandal.

documentaries.title: Senna
documentaries.description: The life and career of Formula One legend Ayrton Senna, told through archive race footage and home video, from his karting days to his death in 1994.

documentaries.title: Super Size Me
documentaries.description: Filmmaker Morgan Spurlock eats only McDonald's for thirty days to examine the effects of fast food on his body and on American culture.

documentaries.title: Seaspiracy
documentaries.description: A filmmaker's love of the ocean turns into an investigation of the global fishing industry and the damage it does to marine life.

documentaries.title: Man on Wire
documentaries.description: In 1974, Philippe Petit and his crew secretly rigged a wire between the Twin Towers and he walked across it. This is the story of that illegal, impossible act.
